profile.name: EPICS 标量计数通道配置组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于 synApps/EPICS 的标量计数记录中管理各计数通道。它主要按 EPICS 通道名称进行名称匹配与通道筛选，方便在实验中整理并选择需要采集的计数信号。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for managing channels in a synApps/EPICS scaler record. It is mainly used to match channel names and select channels based on EPICS naming, helping experiments organize and choose which counting signals to acquire.

registry.name: EPICS 定标器通道
registry.description: EPICS 定标器通道是由EPICS (Argonne National Lab)生产的电子天平。支持Signal, Slot, match name等操作。
